body: One of my many blessings in 2010 – getting to meet and interact with some of the insightful, creative, and courageous people who are leading many of our denominations in America (and elsewhere too) … leaders like Gradye Parsons of the Presbyterian Church. If you had the chance to meet these leaders, you’d see why I am hopeful about the future of the church. Here’s a short interview Gradye and I did recently.
